The '''Cholus family''' was a prestigious and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-aligned family from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pencael IV]]. Its members included [[Senn Cholus]], a decorated [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]], and [[Aven Cholus]], and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]] [[operative]].
